title: California Government Code section 8212 - Notary public official bond
claims: Section 8212 provides that every person appointed a notary public shall execute an official bond in the sum of fifteen thousand dollars ($15,000).
Section 8212 provides that the bond shall be in the form of a bond executed by an admitted surety insurer and not a deposit in lieu of bond.
The section carries the notation Amended by Stats. 1996, Ch. 79, Sec. 1, effective January 1, 1997.
